name: ShopLink WebMCP Manifest
description: Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP) tool registry for autonomous AI agents navigating ShopLink.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search curated creator deals and products by keyword, category, or marketplace platform.

query.description: Search terms to match in product titles, tags, or descriptions.

category.description: Category filter (e.g. All, Tech, Fashion, Ethnic, Skincare, Home).

platform.description: Marketplace platform filter (e.g. All, Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra).

returns.description: List of matching product deals with prices, discounts, and direct affiliate links.

tools.name: get_featured_deals
tools.description: Retrieve featured creator picks and verified discount offers.

sortBy.description: Desired sort order for returned deals.
